notas_originais: Midr. Till., beg. עבד לה א' used that idea of R. Yudan as a theme.

definicoes_originais: (ארך) prolongation, length; (sub. אף, or פנים) forbearance.
notas_originais: Koh. R. to VII, 8 א' שהאריך וכ' the forbearance which Samuel showed. Gen. R. s. 70 א' פנים. Y. Ḥag. II, 77 b bot.; a. e. א' ימים length of days, long life.—Gen. R. s. 64 א' ימים lapse of time.
Targ. Is. XXXVIII, 11.

definicoes_originais: preparation, future (v. ורך, Schr. KAT p. 549).
notas_originais: Targ. Jer. XXXI, 5.
Y. Ḥag. I, 76 c bot.; Y. Pes. III, end, 30 b עליית בית א', v. עֲלִייָּה; (Sifré Deut. 41 ערוד; Yalk. ib. 681 שערים; Kidd. 40 b נתזה).
מקום א' a settlement in a desert. Lev. R. s. 35 (ed. אדרימון, Ar. ארימון, corr. acc.). Cant. R. to VII, 11.—Yalk. Jer. 257 אירימון, cmp. אֱירֵימִיאָה.

verbetes.glosa_atual: amuleto; emblema preso a corrente ou anel.
definicoes_originais: (ארס) something tied to the body (περίαμμα), whence an emblem set in a ring or chain (cmp. Deut. VI, 8; Prov. VI, 21, also Sm. Ant. s. v. Amuletum).
notas_originais: . Deut. R. s. 3 הכניסה לו שנים א' (read שני) brought into his house two emblems (of faith); the king, too, זקף לה כנגדן שני א' had two corresponding emblems set for her. Ib. Abraham delivered to his children שני א' two emblems (which they should guard, Gen. XVIII, 19).

verbetes.glosa_atual: arrendatário que cultiva terra por parte da colheita.
definicoes_originais: (ארס) prop. bound, engaged, esp. tenant who tills the owner’s ground for a certain share in the produces, contrad. fr. חכור tenant who pays the landlord a certain rent in kind, irrespective of the yield of the crops.
notas_originais: Y. Bicc. I, end, 64 b. Y. B. Bath. III, 14 a bot. א' שהוריד א' a farmer letting to a sub-farmer. Ex. R. s. 43. Lev. R. s. 1 אֲרִיסוֹ his (the king’s) tenant, i.e. Adam (in paradise); a. fr.— Pl. אֲרִיסִים, אֲרִיסִין. Y. B. Bath. l. c. Y. M. Kat. III, 82 b bot. Deut. R. s. 7; a. fr.—Cmp. עָרִיס.

verbetes.glosa_atual: arrendatário; trabalhador rural; também prometido em casamento.
notas_originais: Targ. Y. Deut. XXIII, 25; 26 Levita (ed. פועל). Targ. Cant. VIII, 11.—Ab. Zar. 21 b א' אריסותיה קעביד the gentile tenant working during the Jewish festive week, works for his tenancy (not as the Jew’s employee). Ḥag. 25 b דינא הוא … א' וכ' it is the tenant’s business to procure kegs &c.—*B. Bath. 55 a דאריסא דפרסאי עד וכ' Rashb. a. l. (ed. אריסותא, Var. דאֲרִישָׂן, שָׂאִין …, דאֲרִישָׂאָן, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note, Ms. M. דאריש') that the tenant of the Persians is such only up to forty years (after which time he is considered a legitimate owner); v. Nim. Jos. to Alf. a. l. [It seems that the Pers. Jews pronounced אֲרִישָׁא a. אֲרִישׁוּתָא, cmp. דִּישְׁתָּנָא a. דִּיסְתָּנָא.]— Pl. אֲרִיסַיָּא. Targ. Job XXIX, 23. אֲרִישָׂאִין, v. supra. [Lev. R. s. 28, v. אֲרִיסְטָא.]
Tosef. Kel. B. Bath. IV, 8; v. עֲרִיסָה

definicoes_originais: (אָרִיס II) tenancy, condition of the Aris.

Lev. R. s. 5. Ab. Zar. 21 b; a. e. B. Bath. 55 a, v. אֲרִיסָא. [M. Kat. 22 b, v. אֲרִישְׂתָּא.]

definicoes_originais: (corrupt. of אריסטיטא, ἀριστητής) break-fasting, in gen. invited guest.
notas_originais: Pl. אֲרִיסְטִין, אֲרִיסְטַיָּיא. Koh. R. to I, 3 שביק א' וכ' let the guests eat (some ed. אריסטון, our guests?). Lev. R. s. 28 אריסייא (corr. acc.). Lam. R. to IV, 2 ביני א' among the seated guests.

definicoes_originais: (Ἀριστόβουλος) Aristobule, brother of Hyrcan, son of Alexander Jannai.

verbetes.glosa_atual: refeição oferecida na expectativa de retribuição.
definicoes_originais: (ארשׁ, v. ארס) prop. obligation, hence (sub. סעודת) a meal which creates an obligation, a meal which is given in the expectation of receiving invitations from the reciprocating members of a social club, opp. פורענא the entertainment in reciprocation for invitations received.
notas_originais: M. Kat. 22 b אריש' Ar. (ed. אריסותא, Ms. M. ארשיותא, read ארישו').

definicoes_originais: (ארת, √אר, cmp. יְאוֹר) cut, channel, dyke Targ. Ps. CVII, 35 (h. text אגם); a. e.—Ḥull.
notas_originais: 107 a א' דדלאי dyke for irrigation. B. Kam. 50 b sq.— Pl. (אֲרִיתַּ') אֲרִיתַיָּא. Targ. O. Ex. VIII, 11. Targ. Ps. LXXVIII, 44. (h. text יְאֹר); a. e. Cmp. חריץ.

definicoes_originais: (√אר, cmp. ארג) to join, weave; whence to arrange, plan; v. ערך.
notas_originais: —V. אֲרִיךְ II, אֲרוּכָה &c.

verbetes.glosa_atual: ser longo; crescer; durar; prolongar ou demorar.
definicoes_originais: , cmp. Schr. KAT p. 497 ארג; cmp. also גדל to plait,to be tall) to be [ pointed, stretched,] long, tall.
to prolong, be long in doing.
[ to lengthen the carrying pole,] to make heavy.
notas_originais: Ber. I, 4 אמרו להַאֲרִיךְ they commended a lengthy benediction. Ib. 34 a; cmp. אַרְכָן. Yoma 35 b הֶאֱ' בתפלתו staid long in prayer.—הא' ימים to live long. Meg. 27 b; a. fr.—Ber. 8 b, a. fr. מַאֲרִיכִין ימיו his life will be prolonged.—פנים, הא' רוח to be long-suffering, forbearing. Y. Shebu. IV, beg. 35 b; a. fr.—Y. Taan. II, 65 b bot. when collecting debts (punishing) מאריך וגובה he is slow in collecting (punishes in long intervals, gives extension).
Num. R. s. 20, end הא' הברזל the point of the spear grew longer, v. infra; a. fr.
Nidd. 16 b כמה הֶאֱרַכְתָּ עלינו how heavy thou hast made our burden (through restrictive laws)!
Sifré Num. 131; Yalk. ib. 771; (Num. R. l. c. האריך).
, v. אֲרִיךְ I

verbetes.glosa_atual: paciente; longânimo; que suporta por muito tempo.

Targ. II Chr. XXIV, 13.— Pl. (אֲרוּכִין) אַרְכִין. Targ. Ps. CXLVII, 3 (ed. Vien. ארכא).

Targ. Esth. V, 9. [Y. Maasr. V, end, 52 a אביבא דפילא, read ארכובא or עניבה; Y. Ned. III, 37 d bot.; Y. Shebu. III, 34 d.]— Pl. אַרְכּוּבָתָא. Targ. Koh. XII, 3. Targ. II, Esth. VI, 11.—אַרְכּוּבַיָּא Targ. Job. IV, 4.—V. רְכוּבְתָּא.

notas_originais: XI, 2 (h. text נגיד). Targ. Job. XXI, 28 (h. text נדיב); a. fr.—Y. Ber. V, 9 a עבר א' an elder passed by.— Pl. אַרְכוֹנִין. Targ. II Chr. XI, 11; a. e.—Y. Peah VIII, 21 a (defective sentence); [h. pl. אַרְכוֹנוֹת, v. ארְכָן).

Y. Taan. IV, 69 a top. Lam. R. to II, 2; IV, 18. Gen. R. s. 76 ארכוננוס (corr. acc.). [The office of a city mayor or senator in the Roman days was often ruinous to its occupants; v. Sm. Ant. s. v. Senatus.]

II, end, 81 b מעלה לאַרְכִיָים he (the gentile) takes the deed to their (gentile) office for recording. Y. Gitt. Ib. a prefect שהיה בא' שלו who was in his office; a. fr.— Pl. אַרְכִיּוֹת. Ruth. R. l. c. א' א' הן the terms of office are predestined (cmp. Sabb. 30 a bot. ואין מלכות וכ'). [עַרְכָאוֹת, v. עַרְכִי.]

Gen. R. s. 24, beg. לא' שבנה וכ' to be compared to an engineer that built the fortifications of a principality; Num. R. s. 9, beg. לארכי קיטון קטאד' (corr. acc., and insert שנעשה) to an architect that was appointed &c.; a. fr.— Pl. אַרְכִיטֶקְטוֹנִין, אַרְכִיטֶקְטִין. Y. Ber. IX, 13 a top טקטנן … (corr. acc.).

R. s. 34 אתון מארמאין, read מיזדמאין, v. זְמֵי.]—Fem. אַרְמַיְיתָא. Yeb. l. c. V. אֲרַמָּא.
Ab. Zar. 24 b praised בדביר א' in the innermost of the Palace (Temple). [Ex. R. s. 5 בית א'; Pesik. Zakh. p. 27 a, v. אַרְכִיּוֹן.] Cmp. ארם Schr. KAT p. 536.

verbetes.glosa_atual: arameu; aramaico; também romano ou gentio.
